title: Increase orders with promotions | Wolt for Merchants - Wolt (Estonia)

facts.fact: Wolt states that merchants using promotions see an uplift of 30-45% during campaign weeks, per Wolt internal data.
facts.quote: Merchants using promotions see an uplift of 30-45% during campaign weeks.\*

facts.fact: Wolt claims a business featured in the most visible places across the Wolt app could see impressions increase by up to 150%.
facts.quote: potentially increasing impressions by up to 150%.\*

facts.fact: Wolt states that 96% of venues that used Wolt Ads increased their venue visits up to 4x during their campaign period.
facts.quote: 96% of the venues that used Wolt Ads increased their venue visits up to 4x during their campaign period.

facts.fact: Wolt Ads are billed only when an order is placed through the ad; merchants are not charged for clicks or impressions.
facts.quote: You only pay for ads when an order is placed through it – you aren’t charged for clicks or impressions.

facts.fact: Wolt charges for promotions only on confirmed orders placed through the promotion, with the cost deducted from the next payment Wolt makes to the merchant.
facts.quote: You only pay for confirmed orders placed through your promotion. ... The cost of the promotion will be deducted from the following payment made by Wolt.

facts.fact: Wolt's Discount for Customers promotion lets merchants offer a percentage or euro-amount discount, and merchants can set a minimum subtotal.
facts.quote: Attract new customers or win back inactive customers with a percentage or € amount discount. Set a minimum subtotal to increase ticket sizes.

facts.fact: Wolt's promotion types include a discount, a €0 delivery fee for new customers, and a free or discounted item such as 'buy one get 1 free'.
facts.quote: €0 Delivery Fee for New Customers: Entice customers by covering the delivery fee when they place an order from your business.

facts.fact: To create a Wolt promotion campaign, the user must have the Access Role of 'Merchant Owner' or 'Venue Owner'.
facts.quote: To create a campaign, users will need to have Access Role of "Merchant Owner" or "Venue Owner".

facts.fact: Wolt campaigns can be adjusted or ended at any time after launch.
facts.quote: You can make adjustments or end your campaign at any time.

facts.fact: Wolt says merchants create promotions in the Campaigns tab of the Merchant Portal by clicking 'New campaign', choosing a campaign type, setting a duration, and launching.
facts.quote: navigate to the Campaigns tab and click "New campaign". Choose the type of campaign you want to run based on your goals.

facts.fact: Promotions appear to target customers on the 'Offers near you' carousel on the Discovery page, in searches, and on the store page, with a badge added while a promotion runs.
facts.quote: on the "Offers near you" carousel found on the Discovery page, and in searches. When a promotion is running, a corresponding badge is added to those locations.

facts.fact: Wolt states that the Wolt Offers tab on the app is where a business's promotion is prominently featured to its target audience.
facts.quote: your business will be prominently featured to your target audience in the Offers tab on the Wolt app.

facts.fact: Wolt's promotion-uplift and impression figures are averages across partners from internal Wolt data covering January 2022 to July 2023, and actual results may vary.
facts.quote: Internal Wolt data, January 2022 to July 2023. Results are averages across partners. Actual results may vary based on campaign setup.
